answer: The tide graph is validated at intake and the river frontier is published, and thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and ivory anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Forging one identity takes 18 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 309 takes that multiplied out, plus 59 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
